policy_as_code.purpose: Machine-testable policy decisions for autonomous action boundaries.

identity_credential_permission_broker.purpose: Issue bounded access leases without storing long-lived credentials in agent state.

software_supply_chain_provenance_guard.purpose: Require source, dependency, build and artifact integrity evidence before release claims.

continuous_resilience_chaos_verification.purpose: Continuously exercise failure scenarios without Production execution authority.

customer_portability_exit_guarantee.purpose: Require portability and exit evidence before representing handover as complete.

autonomous_business_health_governor.purpose: Use verified business-health evidence to constrain admission or prioritisation without silently changing commercial commitments.

invariants: Unknown policy or authority state fails closed
Agent access is least privilege, task scoped and time bounded
Secrets are never embedded in ordinary work packages, logs or evidence manifests
Release claims require immutable provenance and artifact integrity evidence
Chaos and resilience verification is non-production and has no customer-impacting execution authority
Customer portability composes the existing Handover & Exit Package rather than creating a competing source of truth
Business health automation may constrain admission and priority but may not invent pricing, contractual promises or customer commitments
Production deployment, destructive production data action and privilege widening remain human-only
